brief:
Neil Sammonds called on Britain to better align its policy toward Israel with international law requirements, Middle East Eye reported. The statement urged stronger accountability mechanisms for what Sammonds characterized as crimes against Palestinians, extending the focus beyond the Israeli settlement enterprise alone.

Sammonds's comments, made Friday, appeared to challenge the current scope of UK policy on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. The remarks suggested that existing British positions fall short of the legal standards and oversight mechanisms necessary to address Palestinian grievances comprehensively.

title: Britain should strengthen Israel accountability measures, says Sammonds
